programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts
programme.desc: The prime suspect had a criminal record and his driver's license was found at the scene of a brutal double homicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Haunts Me
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be is shot and left for dead. To catch her assailant, Kenda must elicit a death-bed confession from the victim herself.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Joker In the Pack
programme.desc: A card game is interrupted by gunfire, leaving a young man dead. Lt. Joe Kenda soon learns the seeds of his destruction were sewn earlier the same day.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Winter’s Bone
programme.desc: High in the mountains above Colorado Springs, a woman’s frozen body is found along a switchback road. Investigators need to figure out what brought her here in the first place.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Animal Nature
programme.desc: When a young woman is found mysteriously slaughtered on the steps of a trailer, Kenda and the homicide team must track down the vile perpetrators that are responsible

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: The Darkness of Nights
programme.desc: On a cold Virginia night, a pretty and popular teenage girl vanishes. As snow blankets the region, worry grows, leaving everyone to wonder: where’s Tara Munsey?

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Frozen In Fear
programme.desc: A routine check turns deadly when a cop is gunned down on an icy midnight patrol. A chilling twist and a brush with death turns the investigation on its head.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: iCarly: Tærtemysteriet
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Spencer tager Freddie med til deres yndlingskonditori, finder de ud af, at forpagteren er død. Men endnu værre er, hans opskrifter er måske gået tabt for evigt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anderledes jul
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at pifte julen op med et utraditionelt træ, kommer Spencer til at sætte ild til alle Carlys gaver. Fortvivlet ønsker hun, at hun havde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Det første kys
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortælle Carly, at han aldrig har kysset en pige, og afslører hans hemmelighed på netshowet. Gibby og Carly træner Spencer til udtagelser for det lokale professionelle fodboldhold.

programme.title: iCarly: Hvem vil have en bil?
programme.desc: Slænget kører en konkurrence på iCarly, og præmien er en ny til fra en lokal forhandler. Da Nevel vinder, opdager børnene, at forhandleren ikke kendte noget til konkurrencen eller bilen, de skulle give væk.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg møder Fred
programme.desc: Freddie siger offentligt, at han ikke er en fan af internetsensationen Fred, og får Fred til at meddele, at han holder op med at lave sine videoer. Hans fans bliver rasende over, at Freddie fik stoppet de populære videoer.

programme.title: iCarly: Et perfekt match
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniger sig ud for at tage til en MMA-kamp, får de deres dobbeltgængere til at snøre Spencer til at tro, at de stadig er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kæmpe version af Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi valgte vinderen
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie opfordrer iCarly-fans til at stemme på David Archuleta i Amerika Synger, får de ondt af nummer to og hjælper ham med at lave en musikvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: En sødere Sam
programme.desc: Da Sam indrømmer, at hun kan lide en dreng i skolen, lærer Carly hende, hvordan hun besnærer ham ved at opføre sig mere piget. Spencer er overbevist om, at en pige kan lide ham pga. hans smoking, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 1
programme.desc: Da Carly dater er en hård negl, prøver hun at holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for at bygge en hjemmeside med alle hendes klamme video-favoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.title: iCarly: Mesterskabet
programme.desc: Da Sam og Freddie vinder konkurrencen for bedste skoleskab begge to, bliver de tvunget til at dele skab. Carly beder Spencer give hende timer i billedkunst.

programme.desc: Daniel lærer hvilke af hans private dele, der er brandfarlige og giver ting væk gratis, og en entusiastisk mand, som kan lide barnemad, får genoprejsning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Hey, Baby Girl
programme.desc: Daniel hjælper Bill Gates med at skabe et produkt, som folk kan lide at bruge og lærer Georgia lidt om borgerrettigheder. Desuden får en dreng med bar overkrop genoprejsning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Fired For Being Too Hot
programme.desc: Daniel kommer 'sex' tilbage i sexchikane, gør dig endnu mere paranoid om at bo på hotel og hylder træer før Arbor Day og '420'. Og kvinde, der blev fyret, fordi hun var for flot, får genoprejsning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Pussy Power
programme.desc: Daniel taler med et barn, der har sugemærker over hele kroppen, sender masser af penge til en fremmed på nettet og laver et CeWEBrity-portræt.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Ready to Mingle
programme.desc: Daniel bliver inviteret til skolebal, afslører alt om sommerens film og en produktiv og psykotisk artist, Tonetta, får genoprejsning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Nerf Hoops
programme.desc: Daniel gør sin afrikanske afløser mere afstumpet og overvejer at begå selvmord. Og verdens bedste Nerf-dunker får genoprejsning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Furries Kid
programme.desc: I efterårspremieren afslører Daniel sit mest vovede tøjvalg hidtil, redder en furry fra et kattehjem og laver nogle frække sjove numre.

programme.title: Tosh.0: U-S-A Chant Fail
programme.desc: Daniel viser os det mest pinlige, der er sket i New York, siden Jets valg af "The Sanchize" og løser alt det, der er galt med unge amerikanere.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Lohanthony
programme.desc: Daniel møder en prinsesse, som man ønsker kommer ud for en bilulykke, lærer om et magisk objekt, der kommer tilbage, når man kaster det, og Lohanthony får genoprejsning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Bad DJ
programme.desc: Daniel spiller en ubehagelig omgang af 'Er det racistisk?' og beder dig om hjælp til at opfostre den datter, han håber, at han aldrig får. Og en DJ får genoprejsning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Carnival
programme.desc: Daniel forklarer, hvorfor sovs er efterårets officielle drik, og fyren, som gav alle sine sparepenge væk i bytte for en banan med dreadlocks, får genoprettelse på nettet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Criminals

programme.title: The Roast of Justin Bieber

programme.title: The Roast of Rob Lowe
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er Rob Lowes tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.
